content:
Search API একটি Product-এর সবচেয়ে বেশি ব্যবহৃত ফিচারগুলোর একটি। এটি শুধু "কিছু দেখায়" — এটুকু দেখলেই হবে না। Relevance, Performance, Special Characters এবং Injection — সব দিক থেকে পরীক্ষা করতে হয়।

---

Positive Test Cases

TC-SEARCH-001: Exact match search
Method: GET /api/products?search=iPhone+15
Expected:
  - Status: 200 OK
  - Result contains product named "iPhone 15"
  - Relevant results first

TC-SEARCH-002: Partial match search
Query: search=ipho
Expected: Returns products matching "iPhone" (partial word match)

TC-SEARCH-003: Case-insensitive search
Query: search=IPHONE (uppercase)
Expected: Same results as "iphone" (lowercase)
---

Negative & Edge Case Tests

TC-SEARCH-004: Empty search query
Query: search=
Expected:
  - Status: 200 with all results (or 400 if empty search not allowed)

TC-SEARCH-005: Search with no matching results
Query: search=xyznonexistentproduct123
Expected:
  - Status: 200 OK
  - Response: { "data": [], "total": 0 }
  - NOT 404 (search with no results is not an error)

TC-SEARCH-006: Very long search term (500+ characters)
Query: search= [500 char string]
Expected: 400 Bad Request or truncated search — NOT server crash

TC-SEARCH-007: Special characters in search
Query: search=phone&price (ampersand)
Query: search=O'Connor (apostrophe)
Query: search=hello%20world (URL encoded)
Expected: All handled gracefully, no server error
---

Security Tests

TC-SEARCH-008: SQL Injection via search param
Query: search=' OR '1'='1
Expected: 400 or safe empty result — NOT database error or data leak

TC-SEARCH-009: NoSQL Injection
Query: search={"$gt": ""}
Expected: Treated as plain text — NOT executed as query operator
---

Performance Tests

TC-SEARCH-010: Search response time within SLA
Steps: Run 100 search requests, measure avg response time
Expected: avg < 500ms for simple text search

TC-SEARCH-011: Search with large dataset (1M records)
Expected: Response within SLA, proper indexing in effect
---

পরিশেষে

Search API-এর সবচেয়ে মিস হওয়া টেস্টগুলো হলো Special Character handling এবং Injection tests। একটি unprotected search box থেকে SQL/NoSQL injection করা সম্ভব — এটি কখনো উপেক্ষা করবেন না।

Tags: #SearchAPI #APITesting #SQLInjection #Performance #SpecialChars #QA #SQA
